description: Brown Dust 2 Mod Manager to help you manage mods.

latest_release.name: BD2ModManager v4.4.0
latest_release.body:
If you have feature suggestions or encounter any issues with the mod manager, feel free to open an issue or contact me `@ka. (@bruhnnn)` on Discord.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Mods made for Spine 4.1 don't work with the current game version. They are now marked in the mod list, and the mod manager can convert them to Spine 4.2 (you can back up the original files first). This version also adds Linux support (beta). Please report any problems with converting mods or with Linux.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> 使用 Spine 4.1 制作的模组无法在当前游戏版本中使用。现在它们会在模组列表中标出，模组管理器可以将其转换为 Spine 4.2（可以先备份原始文件）。此版本还新增了 Linux 支持（测试版）。如果在转换模组或使用 Linux 时遇到问题，请提交 issue。

----

## ✨ What's New in v4.4.0
<!-- CHANGELOG -->
- **Added** converting mods made for Spine 4.1 to Spine 4.2, from a prompt at startup, after installing a mod, from the mod list right-click menu or in Settings, with an optional backup of the original files
- **Added** a mod list error for mods made for Spine 4.1 (they can still be enabled, disabled and synced)
- **Added** Linux support as an AppImage and .deb (beta)
- **Added** BD2ModPreview support on Linux (requires a BD2ModPreview release with the AppImage)
- **Added** detection of games installed with Lutris, Heroic, Bottles or Steam on Linux
- **Added** launching the game from a plain Wine prefix on Linux
- **Added** custom themes: create your own themes in Settings, and you can even share them (each theme is a file, found with "Open themes folder")
- **Added** a "Conflicting Mods" list: when a character has more than one enabled mod, choose which one to keep and apply or sync in one step
- **Added** an option to use the game folder (BrownDustX/mods) as the staging folder, to manage mods without syncing. Disabled mods are moved to BrownDustX/mods_disabled (issue #112, contributed by @KuziG1017)
- **Added** auto-detect and recent folders to the directory settings
- **Added** tooltips to action buttons
- **Improved** the mods filters were redesigned
- **Improved** errors when the game can't be launched are now clearer and translated
- **Improved** mod loader installation errors on Linux
- **Improved** missing translations added for Japanese, Korean, Portuguese and Chinese
- **Fixed** symlinked or junction mod folders in the staging folder breaking the mod list (issue #107, contributed by @gy975414111)
- **Fixed** the app asking to sync on first launch when no mods are enabled
- **Fixed** mods being copied again on every sync on Linux
- **Fixed** mod type names in Korean, Portuguese and Traditional Chinese
- **Fixed** dropdowns opening from the wrong position
<!-- CHANGELOG -->

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/bruhnn/BD2ModManager/compare/v4.3.0...v4.4.0 @bruhnn

<!-- @bruhnn -->

detail.readme: # Brown Dust 2 Mod Manager [![GitHub License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/bruhnn/BD2ModManager)](https://github.com/bruhnn/BD2ModManager/blob/main/LICENSE) [![GitHub Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/bruhnn/BD2ModManager)](https://github.com/bruhnn/BD2ModManager/releases) [![Total Downloads](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https://shy-waterfall-2797.bruhnn.workers.dev/downloads)](https://github.com/bruhnn/BD2ModManager/releases) > 🛠 Easily manage, preview, and sync mods for Brown Dust 2. > > 🎉 **Download the latest version:** [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/bruhnn/BD2ModManager/releases) > If you have suggestions or run into any problems with the app, feel free to open an issue or contact me. > [!WARNING] > **Before Uninstalling Brown Dust II !!!** > > If you use the **Symlink** sync method, unsync all mods before uninstalling the game. Otherwise, the game uninstaller may delete your mods from the staging folder. --- ## 🛠️ How to Use 1. **Download** the app from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/bruhnn/BD2ModManager/releases). 2. **Select your Brown Dust 2 directory** (where `BrownDust II.exe` is located) - Example: F:\Neowiz\Browndust2\Browndust2_10000001 3. **Install BepInEx and BrownDustX** - Download both from the BrownDustX Discord: [discord.gg/B3Aqz6tDG2](https://discord.gg/B3Aqz6tDG2) - Manual Steps: **Install BepInEx** Extract the contents of the BepInEx archive into the **game folder** (you can open the game folder from the mod manager) (**NOT** the launcher folder). Your folder should look like this: ```text Browndust2_10000001/ ├─ BepInEx/ ├─ winhttp.dll └─ BrownDust II.exe ``` > The BepInEx archive from the BrownDustX Discord already includes ConfigurationManager. **Install BrownDustX** Extract the `BepInEx` folder from `BrownDustX-[VERSION].zip` into the same game folder. Your folder should look like this: ```text Browndust2_10000001/ ├─ BepInEx/ │ └─ plugins/ │ └─ BrownDustX/ └─ BrownDust II.exe ``` 4. **Verify the installation** - Launch the game. - On the loading screen, the game version and BrownDustX version should appear in red at the top-right corner. 5. **Add your mods** by: - Moving them into the `mods/` folder ⚠️ **Note:** This is *not* the BrownDustX `mods` directory. It's a separate folder used by this manager 6. **Enable or disable mods**. 7. **Sync your mods** to apply changes: - This will create a folder named `BD2MM` inside the `BrownDustX` mods folder with all your enabled mods. > ⚠️ After making any changes (enable, disable, delete, rename), you **must sync** your mods to update the game folder. ### Sync Method: Copy vs Symlink Choose how mods are synced to your BrownDust X `mods` folder: #### 📁 Copy Copies all enabled mods into the folder. - ✅ No admin rights needed - ❌ Slower - ❌ Uses more disk space #### 🔗 Symlink Creates shortcuts instead of copying files. - ✅ Much faster - ✅ Saves disk space - ❌ Requires admin rights #### Example Comparison (383 mods) | Copy | Symlink | |------|---------| | | | --- ## 📸 Screenshots ### Mods Page (v4.0.1) ![Mods Page](./screenshots/mods_page_v401.png) ### Characters Page (v4.0.1) ![Characters Page](./screenshots/characters_page_v401.png) ### Mod Preview (BD2ModPreview v1.0.0) ![Mod Preview](./screenshots/bd2modpreview_v100v2.png) --- ## ❤️ Support the Project If you enjoy the mod manager and want to support development, you can support me here: - Ko-Fi: https://ko-fi.com/bruhnn - Afdian (🇨🇳): https://afdian.com/a/bruhnn ## ❓ FAQ ### Where can I get mods? You can find mods on the BrownDustX Discord server: [https://discord.gg/B3Aqz6tDG2](https://discord.gg/B3Aqz6tDG2) ## 🤝 Credits & Thanks - Character assets by [myssal/Brown-Dust-2-Asset](https://github.com/myssal/Brown-Dust-2-Asset) - Thanks to **Synae** for *BrownDustX* - Thanks to everyone who contributed by reporting bugs and suggesting features. ![Alt](https://repobeats.axiom.co/api/embed/ed16651a70e0b4d1937e8e346f394c6b78c9a231.svg "Repobeats analytics image") ## ✨ Star History
